definitions.explanation: A person who oversleeps or has difficulty waking up. Used affectionately or teasingly, especially toward children or close friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{寝坊助|ねぼうすけ}、⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{起|お}き→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧！
⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寝坊助|ねぼうすけ}で、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}こされている→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: My little brother is a sleepyhead and gets woken up by our mother every morning.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寝坊助|ねぼうすけ}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧になって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧になった。
examples.english: I was a sleepyhead as a child, but I naturally became an early riser after I started working.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{寝坊|ねぼう}→寝坊：01692_nebou⟧ (oversleeping) + すけ (a suffix used to characterize a person, often with a playful or teasing tone). The すけ suffix appears in other character-describing words like {甘|あま}えんぼうすけ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寝坊助|ねぼうすけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to wake up a sleepyhead
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{寝坊助|ねぼうすけ}: you sleepyhead (affectionate scolding)

REGISTER:
Mostly informal and affectionate. Commonly used by parents addressing children or among close friends. Not used in formal or business contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寝坊|ねぼう}→寝坊：01692_nebou⟧: oversleeping (the act itself, not the person)
- ⟦{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}→朝寝坊：02516_asanebou⟧: sleeping in, morning oversleeping
